## Description and Rationale

Solo entry. I'm a software engineer who runs a small network of ADS-B and MLAT receiver stations. Recently worked on an mlat-server implementation in Rust (mlatd). Heard about the challenge through OpenSky's discord, and thought it would be fun to enter and challenge myself working on this problem.
